name: sidebar-layout
title: SidebarLayout
description: Application shell: a collapsible sidebar (expanded, 64px icon rail or off-canvas) with header, body and footer slots, a topbar (workspace switcher, breadcrumb, ⌘K, notifications, theme, user menu) and the main region. Below lg the sidebar moves into a left Drawer opened from the topbar menu button. The collapsed state is controllable and can persist in localStorage (storageKey). Fills its container; fullScreen switches to h-dvh.
author: gntik-ai
